title: bystropogon × schmitzii
intro: Bystropogon × schmitzii, commonly known as the hybrid of Bystropogon citriodorus and Bystropogon foeniculum, is a hybrid plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from digestive issues, due to its ability to aid in digestion and reduce symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Bystropogon × schmitzii include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it effective in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
